content:
mira: Kickoff note: need a concise plan for tenant classification + surge tiers for Dedicated GA. Customers asked for clear SLAs and predictable billing during spikes. Goal: decide tenant classes, core quota model, and minimal ops requirements by EOD Mon.
vanya-product: proposed tenant classes: `baseline` (dev/small), `standard` (payg, moderate traffic), `enterprise` (reserved + SLA). Each has default quota slab + optional surge bundle. Thoughts?
julie-eng: sounds reasonable. important runtime constraints: reserved pools can reserve GPU slots or reserve throughput tokens. Reserving slots is simpler for latency SLOs; tokens are cheaper but harder to enforce.
sam-ops: ops preference: reserve slots for enterprise to avoid noisy neighbors. tokens ok for baseline/standard. Also want an emergency throttle gate that ops can flip per-pool.
cheng: on quota slabs: suggest a three-slab model per tenant class (low/med/high) with clear units: `concurrent_slots` and `burst_tokens`. Example: standard-low = 10 slots, 1k tokens/5m.
kevin-eng: algorithm for smoothing we like: token-bucket per-tenant + shared soft-headroom on pool. Pseudocode: 
```
# refill every second
tenant.tokens = min(cap, tenant.tokens + refill_rate)
if tenant.tokens >= request_cost: allow()
else: if pool.soft_headroom > 0: borrow_from_pool()
else: queue_or_throttle()
```
lena-cs: CS asks: for customers who buy surge bundles, can carryover apply? Acme wants unused tokens to roll forward for 24h.
acme-cs: we're seeing big spikes around campaign windows; if unused burst is lost we get frustrated. carryover for 24h would be ideal.
julie-eng: engineering tradeoff: carryover across windows means storing per-tenant balances and reconciliations. we can do it but need limits to prevent unbounded use. propose rules: carryover cap = 2x purchased burst per tenant, decay_policy = linear over 24h after day boundary.
mira: let's record that as a compromise: carryover=yes behind feature-flag for enterprise + purchased surge bundles; cap=2x, decay=24h linear. Pilot only.
kevin-eng: billing edge cases: if tenant uses borrow_from_pool (soft_headroom) then we either bill immediately or reconcile nightly and charge burst usage. Ops need visibility.
sam-ops: require audit log entries on: grant, borrow, carryover_credit_change, overflow_event. Also console tiles: pool_util, soft_headroom_used, queued_requests, tenant_burst_balance. (1w)
cheng: SLA numbers proposal for enterprise reserved: p95 < 100ms, p99 < 400ms under committed load; best-effort under burst but with SLA promise for baseline latency if within reserved slots.
vanya-product: prioritization for GA pilot (3 customers):
1) tenant classification + quota slabs + billing mapping
2) reserve-slots for enterprise + token model for others
3) smoothing (token-bucket) + soft-headroom borrow
4) basic carryover behind FF for enterprise surge bundles
5) console tiles + audit logs
6) billing reconciliation job + FAQ
mira: launch gating checklist (pilot):
- instrumentation: pool & tenant metrics available in console 
- throttle & emergency gate in place and tested
- one enterprise customer onboarded to reserve-slots with SLA tests passing 
- carryover feature flagged, billing reconciliation dry-run completed
- runbook for ops + CS with prewarm checklist and incident playbook
- legal signoff on SLA wording
kevin-eng: testing plan: load-run with synthetic tenants (standard + enterprise) at 2x expected peak, plus chaos test that kills 1/3 of pool GPUs to validate preempt & fallback. We should run 3 iterations.
julie-eng: rough ETA: implementing token-bucket smoothing + pool soft-headroom borrow = 3w. reserve-slots path + billing mapping = 4w. carryover feature-flag + reconciliation job = 3w after billing APIs ready.
lena-cs: CS asks to surface a simple matrix in one-pager for customers: tenant class, what's guaranteed, what's billed, what carryover looks like. I'll draft.
mira: ops action: sam to start emergency gate runbook and telemetry requirements. eng action: julie/kevin to prototype token-bucket + pool-headroom borrowing. product: vanya to finalize tier names and pricing buckets; cs: lena to draft customer one-pager.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: `dedicated/smoothing:v1-canary` tomorrow 03:30 UTC.
acme-cs: please include Acme in pilot for carryover FF. happy to provide real traffic windows.
mira: noted. will add Acme. Closing: we'll reconvene Thurs 10am to validate dev progress. :+1:
